```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false


# ============================================================
# PACKAGES
# ============================================================
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggalluvial)

# ============================================================
# DATA IMPORT
# ============================================================
data <- read_excel(
 "data/TIM_POP_database_FINAL.xlsx",
 sheet = "Inclusion" )
dict <- read_excel(
 "data/TIM_POP_database_FINAL.xlsx",
 sheet = "Dictionnaire variable" )

# ============================================================
# DATABASE QUALITY CONTROL
# ============================================================
qc_population <- tibble(
 Parameter = c(
   "Number of observations",
   "Number of variables",
   "Unique patient identifiers",
   "Duplicated patient identifiers"
 ),
 Value = c(
   nrow(data),
   ncol(data),
   n_distinct(data$Numero),
   sum(duplicated(data$Numero))
 ) )
stopifnot(nrow(data) == 122)
stopifnot(n_distinct(data$Numero) == 122)
stopifnot(sum(duplicated(data$Numero)) == 0)

# ============================================================
# KEY VARIABLES
# ============================================================
key_variables <- c(
 "type_prelevement_preeot",
 "pathogene_preeot",
 "pathogene_preeot_2",
 "pathogene_preeot_3",
 "adequation_antibiotherapie_probabiliste",
 "echec_traitement_initial",
 "adaptation_ATB_48h",
 "resistance_phenotypique_germe" )

# ============================================================
# CLEAN BINARY / NUMERIC VARIABLES
# ============================================================
data <- data |>
 mutate(
   adequacy = suppressWarnings(
     as.numeric(adequation_antibiotherapie_probabiliste)
   ),
   initial_failure = suppressWarnings(
     as.numeric(echec_traitement_initial)
   ),
   adaptation_48h = suppressWarnings(
     as.numeric(adaptation_ATB_48h)
   ),
   resistance_code = suppressWarnings(
     as.numeric(resistance_phenotypique_germe)
   )
 )
stopifnot(
 all(na.omit(unique(data$adequacy)) %in% c(0, 1)) )
stopifnot(
 all(na.omit(unique(data$initial_failure)) %in% c(0, 1)) )
stopifnot(
 all(na.omit(unique(data$adaptation_48h)) %in% c(0, 1)) )

# ============================================================
# MICROBIOLOGICAL DICTIONARY
# ============================================================
pathogen_labels <- c(
 `0` = "No microorganism",
 `1` = "MSSA",
 `2` = "Oropharyngeal flora",
 `3` = "Enterococcus faecium",
 `4` = "Citrobacter freundii",
 `5` = "Hafnia alvei",
 `6` = "Klebsiella pneumoniae",
 `7` = "Escherichia coli",
 `8` = "Pseudomonas aeruginosa",
 `9` = "Proteus mirabilis",
 `10` = "Corynebacterium spp.",
 `11` = "Serratia marcescens",
 `12` = "Enterobacter aerogenes",
 `13` = "Enterococcus faecalis",
 `14` = "Haemophilus influenzae",
 `15` = "Acinetobacter baumannii",
 `16` = "Staphylococcus epidermidis",
 `17` = "Moraxella catarrhalis",
 `18` = "Staphylococcus haemolyticus",
 `19` = "Mycoplasma pneumoniae",
 `20` = "Enterobacter cloacae",
 `21` = "Stenotrophomonas maltophilia",
 `22` = "Streptococcus pneumoniae" )
label_pathogen <- function(x) {
 unname(pathogen_labels[as.character(x)]) }

# ============================================================
# PRE-EXTUBATION SAMPLING
# ============================================================
data <- data |>
 mutate(
   preeot_performed = case_when(
     type_prelevement_preeot == 0 ~ FALSE,
     type_prelevement_preeot %in% 1:4 ~ TRUE,
     TRUE ~ NA
   )
 )
n_total <- nrow(data)
n_performed <- sum(
 data$preeot_performed == TRUE,
 na.rm = TRUE )
n_not_performed <- sum(
 data$preeot_performed == FALSE,
 na.rm = TRUE )

# ============================================================
# PRE-EOT MICROBIOLOGICAL YIELD
# ============================================================
data <- data |>
 rowwise() |>
 mutate(
   preeot_positive = any(
     c_across(
       c(
         pathogene_preeot,
         pathogene_preeot_2,
         pathogene_preeot_3
       )
     ) > 0,
     na.rm = TRUE
   )
 ) |>
 ungroup()
n_positive <- sum(
 data$preeot_performed &
   data$preeot_positive,
 na.rm = TRUE )
n_negative <- sum(
 data$preeot_performed &
   !data$preeot_positive,
 na.rm = TRUE )
yield_preeot <- 100 * n_positive / n_performed
yield_ci <- 100 * binom.test(
 n_positive,
 n_performed )$conf.int
stopifnot(
 n_positive + n_negative == n_performed )

# ============================================================
# POSITIVE PRE-EOT SAMPLES
# ============================================================
preEOT_pos <- data |>
 filter(
   preeot_performed,
   preeot_positive
 ) |>
 select(
   Numero,
   pathogene_preeot,
   pathogene_preeot_2,
   pathogene_preeot_3,
   pathogene_ppo,
   pathogene_ppo_2,
   pathogene_ppo_3,
   adequacy,
   adaptation_48h,
   resistance_code,
   date_prelevement_preeot,
   date_diagnostic_ppo
 )
stopifnot(
 nrow(preEOT_pos) == n_positive )

# ============================================================
# BROAD MICROBIOLOGICAL CONCORDANCE
# ============================================================
preEOT_pos <- preEOT_pos |>
 rowwise() |>
 mutate(
   concordant = {
      pre <- c(
       pathogene_preeot,
       pathogene_preeot_2,
       pathogene_preeot_3
     )
      pop <- c(
       pathogene_ppo,
       pathogene_ppo_2,
       pathogene_ppo_3
     )
      pre <- pre[
       !is.na(pre) &
         pre > 0
     ]
      pop <- pop[
       !is.na(pop) &
         pop > 0
     ]
      length(intersect(pre, pop)) > 0
   }
 ) |>
 ungroup()
n_concordant <- sum(
 preEOT_pos$concordant )
n_discordant <- sum(
 !preEOT_pos$concordant )
concordance_ci <- 100 * binom.test(
 n_concordant,
 n_positive )$conf.int

# ============================================================
# SPECIFIC CONCORDANCE EXCLUDING OROPHARYNGEAL FLORA
# ============================================================
preEOT_pos <- preEOT_pos |>
 rowwise() |>
 mutate(
   concordant_specific = {
      pre <- c(
       pathogene_preeot,
       pathogene_preeot_2,
       pathogene_preeot_3
     )
      pop <- c(
       pathogene_ppo,
       pathogene_ppo_2,
       pathogene_ppo_3
     )
      pre <- pre[
       !is.na(pre) &
         pre > 0 &
         pre != 2
     ]
      pop <- pop[
       !is.na(pop) &
         pop > 0 &
         pop != 2
     ]
      length(intersect(pre, pop)) > 0
   }
 ) |>
 ungroup()
n_specific_concordant <- sum(
 preEOT_pos$concordant_specific )
specific_concordance_ci <- 100 * binom.test(
 n_specific_concordant,
 n_positive )$conf.int

# ============================================================
# EMPIRICAL ANTIMICROBIAL ADEQUACY
# ============================================================
n_adequacy_available <- sum(
 !is.na(data$adequacy) )
n_adequate <- sum(
 data$adequacy == 1,
 na.rm = TRUE )
n_inadequate <- sum(
 data$adequacy == 0,
 na.rm = TRUE )
stopifnot(
 n_adequate + n_inadequate ==
   n_adequacy_available )
adequacy_by_preeot <- data |>
 filter(
   !is.na(adequacy)
 ) |>
 group_by(
   preeot_positive
 ) |>
 summarise(
   n = n(),
   adequate = sum(adequacy == 1),
   inadequate = sum(adequacy == 0),
   inadequate_percent =
     100 * inadequate / n,
   .groups = "drop"
 )

# ============================================================
# POTENTIAL CLINICAL ACTIONABILITY
# ============================================================
specific_actionability_cases <- preEOT_pos |>
 filter(
   concordant_specific,
   adequacy == 0
 )
n_specific_actionable <- nrow(
 specific_actionability_cases )
pct_specific_actionable_total <-
 100 * n_specific_actionable /
 n_total
pct_specific_actionable_positive <-
 100 * n_specific_actionable /
 n_positive
pct_specific_actionable_specific <-
 100 * n_specific_actionable /
 n_specific_concordant
actionability_ci <- 100 * binom.test(
 n_specific_actionable,
 n_total )$conf.int

# ============================================================
# TIMING
# ============================================================
specific_actionability_cases <-
 specific_actionability_cases |>
 mutate(
   delay_preEOT_POP =
     as.numeric(
       as.Date(date_diagnostic_ppo) -
         as.Date(date_prelevement_preeot)
     )
 )
actionability_timing <- specific_actionability_cases |>
 summarise(
   n = n(),
   median_delay = median(
     delay_preEOT_POP,
     na.rm = TRUE
   ),
   Q1 = quantile(
     delay_preEOT_POP,
     0.25,
     na.rm = TRUE
   ),
   Q3 = quantile(
     delay_preEOT_POP,
     0.75,
     na.rm = TRUE
   )
 )

# ============================================================
# MICROBIOLOGICAL ECOLOGY
# ============================================================
preeot_micro_long <- data |>
 select(
   Numero,
   pathogene_preeot,
   pathogene_preeot_2,
   pathogene_preeot_3
 ) |>
 pivot_longer(
   cols = starts_with("pathogene_preeot"),
   names_to = "rank",
   values_to = "pathogen_code"
 ) |>
 filter(
   !is.na(pathogen_code),
   pathogen_code > 0
 ) |>
 mutate(
   pathogen =
     label_pathogen(pathogen_code)
 )
preeot_micro_summary <- preeot_micro_long |>
 count(
   pathogen,
   sort = TRUE,
   name = "n"
 )
fig_preeot_micro <- preeot_micro_summary |>
 ggplot(
   aes(
     x = reorder(pathogen, n),
     y = n
   )
 ) +
 geom_col(
   width = 0.7,
   fill = "#397FA9"
 ) +
 geom_text(
   aes(label = n),
   hjust = -0.25,
   size = 3.5
 ) +
 coord_flip() +
 labs(
   title =
     "Microorganisms isolated before extubation",
   x = NULL,
   y = "Number of isolates"
 ) +
 theme_classic(
   base_size = 12
 ) +
 theme(
   plot.title =
     element_text(face = "bold")
 ) +
 expand_limits(
   y =
     max(preeot_micro_summary$n) + 3
 )
 pop_micro_long <- data |>
 select(
   Numero,
   pathogene_ppo,
   pathogene_ppo_2,
   pathogene_ppo_3
 ) |>
 pivot_longer(
   cols = starts_with("pathogene_ppo"),
   names_to = "rank",
   values_to = "pathogen_code"
 ) |>
 filter(
   !is.na(pathogen_code),
   pathogen_code > 0
 ) |>
 mutate(
   pathogen =
     label_pathogen(pathogen_code)
 )
pop_micro_summary <- pop_micro_long |>
 count(
   pathogen,
   sort = TRUE,
   name = "n"
 )
fig_pop_micro <- pop_micro_summary |>
 ggplot(
   aes(
     x = reorder(pathogen, n),
     y = n
   )
 ) +
 geom_col(
   width = 0.7,
   fill = "#16857A"
 ) +
 geom_text(
   aes(label = n),
   hjust = -0.25,
   size = 3.5
 ) +
 coord_flip() +
 labs(
   title =
     "Microorganisms isolated at POP diagnosis",
   x = NULL,
   y = "Number of isolates"
 ) +
 theme_classic(
   base_size = 12
 ) +
 theme(
   plot.title =
     element_text(face = "bold")
 ) +
 expand_limits(
   y =
     max(pop_micro_summary$n) + 3
 )

# ============================================================
# MICROBIOLOGICAL SANKEY
# Positive pre-EOT samples only
# ============================================================
micro_trajectories <- preEOT_pos |>
 rowwise() |>
 mutate(
   pre_specific = list(
     unique(
       c(
         pathogene_preeot,
         pathogene_preeot_2,
         pathogene_preeot_3
       )[
         !is.na(
           c(
             pathogene_preeot,
             pathogene_preeot_2,
             pathogene_preeot_3
           )
         ) &
           c(
             pathogene_preeot,
             pathogene_preeot_2,
             pathogene_preeot_3
           ) > 0
       ]
     )
   ),
        pop_specific = list(
     unique(
       c(
         pathogene_ppo,
         pathogene_ppo_2,
         pathogene_ppo_3
       )[
         !is.na(
           c(
             pathogene_ppo,
             pathogene_ppo_2,
             pathogene_ppo_3
           )
         ) &
           c(
             pathogene_ppo,
             pathogene_ppo_2,
             pathogene_ppo_3
           ) > 0
       ]
     )
   )
 ) |>
 ungroup() |>
 select(
   Numero,
   concordant_specific,
   pre_specific,
   pop_specific
 ) |>
 unnest_longer(
   pre_specific,
   values_to = "pre_code"
 ) |>
 unnest_longer(
   pop_specific,
   values_to = "pop_code"
 ) |>
 mutate(
   Pre_EOT_microbiology =
     label_pathogen(pre_code),
        POP_microbiology =
     label_pathogen(pop_code),
        concordance_group =
     if_else(
       concordant_specific,
       "Specific concordance",
       "No specific concordance"
     )
 ) |>
 filter(
   !is.na(Pre_EOT_microbiology),
   !is.na(POP_microbiology)
 ) |>
 count(
   Pre_EOT_microbiology,
   POP_microbiology,
   concordance_group,
   name = "n"
 )
 fig_micro_sankey <- ggplot(
 micro_trajectories,
 aes(
   axis1 = Pre_EOT_microbiology,
   axis2 = POP_microbiology,
   y = n
 ) ) +
 geom_alluvium(
   aes(fill = concordance_group),
   width = 0.12,
   alpha = 0.68,
   knot.pos = 0.45
 ) +
 geom_stratum(
   width = 0.12,
   fill = "#E6EFF5",
   colour = "#526D82",
   linewidth = 0.35
 ) +
# Labels on the LEFT

 geom_text(
   stat = "stratum",
   aes(
     label = ifelse(
       after_stat(x) == 1,
       after_stat(stratum),
       ""
     )
   ),
   hjust = 1,
   nudge_x = -0.08,
   size = 3.2,
   lineheight = 0.9
 ) +
# Labels on the RIGHT

 geom_text(
   stat = "stratum",
   aes(
     label = ifelse(
       after_stat(x) == 2,
       after_stat(stratum),
       ""
     )
   ),
   hjust = 0,
   nudge_x = 0.08,
   size = 3.2,
   lineheight = 0.9
 ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
   values = c(
     "Specific concordance" = "#16857A",
     "No specific concordance" = "#D18A46"
   )
 ) +
    scale_x_discrete(
   limits = c(
     "Pre-extubation",
     "Postoperative pneumonia"
   ),
   expand = c(0.32, 0.32)
 ) +
    labs(
   title =
     "Microbiological trajectories from pre-extubation sampling to postoperative pneumonia",
        subtitle =
     paste0("Positive pre-extubation samples (n = ", n_positive, "); pairwise co-occurrences"),
        x = NULL,
   y = "Number of patient–organism pairs across samples",
   fill = NULL
 ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
   axis.text.y = element_blank(),
   axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
   axis.line.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(
     face = "bold",
     size = 11,
     margin = margin(t = 8)
   ),
        axis.title.y = element_text(
     size = 11,
     margin = margin(r = 12)
   ),
        legend.position = "bottom",
   legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.title = element_text(
     face = "bold",
     size = 14
   ),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(
     size = 11,
     margin = margin(b = 15)
   ),
        plot.margin = margin(
     t = 15,
     r = 180,
     b = 15,
     l = 180
   )
 )

# ============================================================
# ANTIMICROBIAL RESISTANCE
# ============================================================
data <- data |>
 mutate(
   resistance_status = case_when(
     resistance_code == 0 ~
       "No reported resistance",
      resistance_code == 1 ~
       "ESBL",
      resistance_code == 2 ~
       "Carbapenemase",
      resistance_code == 3 ~
       "Methicillin resistance",
      resistance_code == 4 ~
       "Cephalosporinase",
      resistance_code == 5 ~
       "Highly resistant Pseudomonas",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
   ),
    any_resistance = case_when(
     resistance_code == 0 ~ 0,
     resistance_code %in% 1:5 ~ 1,
     TRUE ~ NA_real_
   )
 )
resistance_summary <- data |>
 filter(
   !is.na(resistance_status)
 ) |>
 count(
   resistance_status,
   name = "n"
 ) |>
 mutate(
   percent =
     100 * n / sum(n)
 )
n_resistance_available <- sum(
 !is.na(data$any_resistance) )
n_resistant <- sum(
 data$any_resistance == 1,
 na.rm = TRUE )
pct_resistant <-
 100 * n_resistant /
 n_resistance_available

# ============================================================
# RESISTANCE AND EMPIRICAL INADEQUACY
# ============================================================
resistance_inadequacy <- data |>
 filter(
   !is.na(any_resistance),
   !is.na(adequacy)
 ) |>
 group_by(
   any_resistance
 ) |>
 summarise(
   n = n(),
   inadequate =
     sum(adequacy == 0),
   adequate =
     sum(adequacy == 1),
   inadequacy_percent =
     100 * inadequate / n,
   .groups = "drop"
 ) |>
 mutate(
   resistance = if_else(
     any_resistance == 1,
     "Resistance present",
     "No reported resistance"
   )
 )
table_resistance_inadequacy <- table(
 Resistance = data$any_resistance,
 Inadequate = 1 - data$adequacy,
 useNA = "no" )
fisher_resistance_inadequacy <-
 fisher.test(
   table_resistance_inadequacy
 )
OR_resistance <- unname(
 fisher_resistance_inadequacy$estimate )
CI_resistance <-
 fisher_resistance_inadequacy$conf.int
p_resistance <-
 fisher_resistance_inadequacy$p.value

# ============================================================
# ANTIMICROBIAL ADAPTATION AT 48 HOURS
# ============================================================
n_adaptation_available <- sum(
 !is.na(data$adaptation_48h) )
n_adapted <- sum(
 data$adaptation_48h == 1,
 na.rm = TRUE )
pct_adapted <-
 100 * n_adapted /
 n_adaptation_available
adaptation_by_preeot <- data |>
 filter(
   !is.na(adaptation_48h)
 ) |>
 group_by(
   preeot_positive
 ) |>
 summarise(
   n = n(),
   adapted =
     sum(adaptation_48h == 1),
   not_adapted =
     sum(adaptation_48h == 0),
   adapted_percent =
     100 * adapted / n,
   .groups = "drop"
 )
fisher_adaptation_preeot <-
 fisher.test(
   table(
     data$preeot_positive,
     data$adaptation_48h,
     useNA = "no"
   )
 )
adaptation_by_specific_concordance <-
 preEOT_pos |>
 filter(
   !is.na(adaptation_48h)
 ) |>
 group_by(
   concordant_specific
 ) |>
 summarise(
   n = n(),
   adapted =
     sum(adaptation_48h == 1),
   not_adapted =
     sum(adaptation_48h == 0),
   adapted_percent =
     100 * adapted / n,
   .groups = "drop"
 )

# ============================================================
# CLINICAL OUTCOMES
# ============================================================
outcome_publication <- data |>
 filter(
   !is.na(adequacy)
 ) |>
 mutate(
   empirical_therapy = if_else(
     adequacy == 1,
     "Adequate",
     "Inadequate"
   )
 ) |>
 group_by(
   empirical_therapy
 ) |>
 summarise(
   n = n(),
    ICU_LOS_median =
     median(
       duree_sejour_reanimation,
       na.rm = TRUE
     ),
    ICU_LOS_Q1 =
     quantile(
       duree_sejour_reanimation,
       0.25,
       na.rm = TRUE
     ),
    ICU_LOS_Q3 =
     quantile(
       duree_sejour_reanimation,
       0.75,
       na.rm = TRUE
     ),
    Hospital_LOS_median =
     median(
       duree_sejour_hopital,
       na.rm = TRUE
     ),
    Hospital_LOS_Q1 =
     quantile(
       duree_sejour_hopital,
       0.25,
       na.rm = TRUE
     ),
    Hospital_LOS_Q3 =
     quantile(
       duree_sejour_hopital,
       0.75,
       na.rm = TRUE
     ),
    ICU_death =
     sum(
       dc_reanimation == 1,
       na.rm = TRUE
     ),
    Hospital_death =
     sum(
       dc_hopital == 1,
       na.rm = TRUE
     ),
    POP_recurrence =
     sum(
       recidive_ppo == 1,
       na.rm = TRUE
     ),
    .groups = "drop"
 )
wilcox_icu_los <- wilcox.test(
 duree_sejour_reanimation ~ adequacy,
 data = data,
 exact = FALSE )
wilcox_hospital_los <- wilcox.test(
 duree_sejour_hopital ~ adequacy,
 data = data,
 exact = FALSE )
fisher_icu_death <- fisher.test(
 table(
   data$adequacy,
   data$dc_reanimation,
   useNA = "no"
 ) )
fisher_hospital_death <- fisher.test(
 table(
   data$adequacy,
   data$dc_hopital,
   useNA = "no"
 ) )
fisher_pop_recurrence <- fisher.test(
 table(
   data$adequacy,
   data$recidive_ppo,
   useNA = "no"
 ) )
outcome_tests <- tibble(
 Outcome = c(
   "ICU length of stay",
   "Hospital length of stay",
   "ICU mortality",
   "Hospital mortality",
   "POP recurrence"
 ),
  P_value = c(
   wilcox_icu_los$p.value,
   wilcox_hospital_los$p.value,
   fisher_icu_death$p.value,
   fisher_hospital_death$p.value,
   fisher_pop_recurrence$p.value
 ) )

# ============================================================
# MAIN FIGURE 1 — CLINICAL UTILITY CASCADE
# ============================================================
clinical_utility_cascade <- tibble(
 stage = c(
   "Patients with POP and pre-EOT sampling",
   "Positive pre-EOT microbiology",
   "Specific microbiological concordance",
   "Potentially actionable"
 ),
  n = c(
   n_total,
   n_positive,
   n_specific_concordant,
   n_specific_actionable
 ) ) |>
 mutate(
   percent_total =
     100 * n / n_total,
    stage = factor(
     stage,
     levels = rev(stage)
   )
 )
fig_clinical_utility <- ggplot(clinical_utility_cascade,
 aes(x = percent_total, y = stage, fill = stage)) +
 geom_col(aes(x = 100), fill = "#EDF2F6", width = .65) +
 geom_col(width = .65) +
 geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%d / %d  (%.1f%%)", n, n_total, percent_total)),
           hjust = 0, nudge_x = 2, size = 3.7, fontface = "bold", colour = "#20364A") +
 scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(c("#C66A28", "#16857A", "#397FA9", "#234866"),
                                     levels(clinical_utility_cascade$stage)), guide = "none") +
 scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,100,25), labels = function(x) paste0(x,"%"),
                    limits = c(0,132), expand = expansion(mult = 0)) +
 scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) vapply(x, function(z) paste(strwrap(z,30),collapse="\n"),character(1))) +
 labs(x = "Percentage of the full POP cohort", y = NULL) +

 theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_text(colour="#20364A",face="bold"),

resistance_figure_data <-
 resistance_inadequacy |>
 rowwise() |>
 mutate(
   ci_low =
     100 * binom.test(
       inadequate,
       n
     )$conf.int[1],
    ci_high =
     100 * binom.test(
       inadequate,
       n
     )$conf.int[2]
 ) |>
 ungroup() |>
 mutate(
   resistance = factor(
     resistance,
     levels = c(
       "No reported resistance",
       "Resistance present"
     )
   )
 )
fig_resistance_inadequacy <- ggplot(
 resistance_figure_data,
 aes(

   y = inadequacy_percent,
   fill = resistance
 ) ) +
 geom_col(width = 0.48) +
 scale_fill_manual(values = c("No reported resistance" = "#397FA9", "Resistance present" = "#C66A28"), guide = "none") +
 geom_errorbar(
   aes(
     ymin = ci_low,
     ymax = ci_high
   ),
   colour = "#20364A", linewidth = 0.65,

 ) +
 geom_text(
   aes(
     y = ci_high,
     label = paste0(
       inadequate,
       "/",

       "\n",

       ),
       "%"
     )
   ),
   vjust = -0.4,
   colour = "#20364A", fontface = "bold",
   size = 3.6
 ) +
 labs(

    subtitle = paste0(
     "OR ",

       "%.2f",
       OR_resistance
     ),
     " (95% CI ",
     sprintf(
       "%.2f",

     ),
     "–",

       "%.2f",
       CI_resistance[2]
     ),
     "); P ",
     format.pval(
       p_resistance,
       digits = 3,
       eps = 0.001
     )
   ),
    x = NULL,

     "Inadequate empirical antimicrobial therapy (%)"
 ) +
 theme_classic(
   base_size = 12
 ) +
 theme(
   plot.title =
     element_text(
       face = "bold"
     )
 )

fmt <- function(k, n) if (n > 0) sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%)", k, n, 100*k/n) else "Not evaluable"
continuous <- function(x) {
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x)); x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (!length(x)) return("Not evaluable")
  q <- quantile(x, c(.25,.5,.75))
  sprintf("%.1f [%.1f–%.1f] (n=%d)", q[2],q[1],q[3],length(x))
}
binary <- function(x, code=1) fmt(sum(x == code, na.rm=TRUE),sum(!is.na(x)))

# ============================================================
# ADDITIONAL SENSITIVITY ANALYSES (patient-level)
# ============================================================
ci_fmt <- function(k,n) {
 if (!n) return("Not evaluable")
 z <- 100*binom.test(k,n)$conf.int
 sprintf("%s [%.1f–%.1f%%]",fmt(k,n),z[1],z[2])
}
sets <- function(df, cols) lapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) {
 v <- as.numeric(unlist(df[i,cols],use.names=FALSE)); sort(unique(v[!is.na(v) & v>0 & v!=2]))
})
pre_cols <- c("pathogene_preeot","pathogene_preeot_2","pathogene_preeot_3")
pop_cols <- c("pathogene_ppo","pathogene_ppo_2","pathogene_ppo_3")
sens <- data |> mutate(
 pre_set=sets(data,pre_cols), pop_set=sets(data,pop_cols),
 pre_known=!is.na(pathogene_preeot), pop_known=!is.na(pathogene_ppo),
 specific_pre=lengths(pre_set)>0, specific_pop=lengths(pop_set)>0,
 overlap=mapply(function(a,b) length(intersect(a,b))>0,pre_set,pop_set),
 identical_sets=mapply(function(a,b) length(a)>0 && setequal(a,b),pre_set,pop_set),
 all_pop=mapply(function(a,b) length(b)>0 && all(b %in% a),pre_set,pop_set),
 delay=as.numeric(as.Date(date_diagnostic_ppo)-as.Date(date_prelevement_preeot)),
 adequacy_known=!is.na(adequacy),
 candidate=case_when(!pre_known | !pop_known ~ NA, !overlap ~ FALSE, adequacy_known ~ adequacy==0, TRUE ~ NA),
 surgery=case_when(is.na(intervention) ~ "Unknown",intervention==1 ~ "Liver transplantation",TRUE ~ "Other surgery"),
 sampling=case_when(type_prelevement_preeot==1 ~ "Protected distal sampling",type_prelevement_preeot==2 ~ "Tracheal aspiration",type_prelevement_preeot==3 ~ "Sputum",type_prelevement_preeot==4 ~ "BAL",TRUE ~ "Other/unknown"))
stopifnot(sum(sens$overlap)==n_specific_concordant,sum(sens$candidate %in% TRUE)==n_specific_actionable)
sp <- sens |> filter(preeot_positive,pre_known,pop_known)
missing_summary <- tibble(Variable=c("Empirical adequacy","Pre-EOT primary microbiology code","POP primary microbiology code","Sampling-to-POP delay","Resistance","48-h adaptation"),Missing=c(sum(!sens$adequacy_known),sum(!sens$pre_known),sum(!sens$pop_known),sum(is.na(sens$delay)),sum(is.na(sens$any_resistance)),sum(is.na(sens$adaptation_48h)))) |> mutate(`Missing n/N (%)`=vapply(Missing,function(k)fmt(k,n_total),character(1)))
miss_groups <- split(sens,sens$adequacy_known)
smd <- function(a,b) {a<-a[!is.na(a)];b<-b[!is.na(b)];if(length(a)<2 || length(b)<2)return(NA_real_); den<-sqrt((var(a)+var(b))/2);if(den==0)return(if(mean(a)==mean(b))0 else NA_real_);(mean(a)-mean(b))/den}
miss_vars <- list(Age=sens$age,`SAPS II`=sens$score_igs2,SOFA=sens$score_sofa,`Liver transplantation`=as.numeric(sens$intervention==1),`Prior antibiotics (90 days)`=sens$antibiotherapie_moins_90j,`Positive pre-EOT`=as.numeric(sens$preeot_positive),`Specific overlap`=as.numeric(sens$overlap),`Delay, days`=sens$delay,Resistance=sens$any_resistance,`ICU death`=sens$dc_reanimation)
missing_compare <- bind_rows(lapply(names(miss_vars),function(v){x<-suppressWarnings(as.numeric(miss_vars[[v]]));a<-x[sens$adequacy_known];b<-x[!sens$adequacy_known]; f<-if(v %in% c("Age","SAPS II","SOFA","Delay, days")) continuous else binary;tibble(Variable=v,Evaluable=f(a),`Non-evaluable`=f(b),SMD=smd(a,b))}))
unknown_candidate <- sum(is.na(sens$candidate))
action_sensitivity <- tibble(Scenario=c("Observed candidate proportion","Evaluable composite only","All unknown composite outcomes negative","All unknown composite outcomes positive"),k=c(n_specific_actionable,n_specific_actionable,n_specific_actionable,n_specific_actionable+unknown_candidate),N=c(n_total,n_total-unknown_candidate,n_total,n_total)) |> mutate(Estimate=mapply(fmt,k,N))
concordance_sensitivity <- tibble(Definition=c("Any overlap, flora included (original)","Specific overlap (original)","Specific overlap, specific pre-EOT positive","Identical nonempty specific sets","All specific POP organisms present pre-EOT","All specific POP organisms present, specific POP positive"),k=c(n_concordant,n_specific_concordant,sum(sp$overlap & sp$specific_pre),sum(sp$identical_sets),sum(sp$all_pop),sum(sp$all_pop)),N=c(n_positive,n_positive,sum(sp$specific_pre),nrow(sp),nrow(sp),sum(sp$specific_pop))) |> mutate(`Estimate [95% CI]`=mapply(ci_fmt,k,N))
# Permute whole POP profiles among positive pre-EOT patients with known primary codes.
match_matrix <- outer(seq_len(nrow(sp)),seq_len(nrow(sp)),Vectorize(function(i,j) length(intersect(sp$pre_set[[i]],sp$pop_set[[j]]))>0))
set.seed(20261126)
B <- 10000L
obs_perm <- sum(diag(match_matrix))
perm_counts <- replicate(B,sum(match_matrix[cbind(seq_len(nrow(sp)),sample.int(nrow(sp)))]))
perm_p <- (1+sum(perm_counts>=obs_perm))/(B+1)
perm_expected <- mean(perm_counts)/nrow(sp)*100
fig_perm <- ggplot(tibble(Concordance=100*perm_counts/nrow(sp)),aes(Concordance))+geom_histogram(binwidth=100/nrow(sp),boundary=-50/nrow(sp),fill="#397FA9",colour="white",linewidth=.25)+geom_vline(xintercept=100*obs_perm/nrow(sp),colour="#C66A28",linewidth=1.15,linetype="dashed")+labs(x="Specific concordance (%)",y="Permutations",subtitle=sprintf("Observed %.1f%%; expected %.1f%%; Monte Carlo P = %.4g",100*obs_perm/nrow(sp),perm_expected,perm_p))+theme_classic(base_size=12)
# Calendar-day delay; exclude negative or missing intervals from this analysis only.
time_data <- sp |> filter(!is.na(delay),delay>=0) |> mutate(window=cut(delay,c(-Inf,2,5,Inf),labels=c("0–2 days","3–5 days",">5 days")))
time_table <- time_data |> group_by(window,.drop=FALSE) |> summarise(k=sum(overlap),N=n(),.groups="drop") |> mutate(`Estimate [95% CI]`=mapply(ci_fmt,k,N))
time_fit <- glm(overlap~delay,data=time_data,family=binomial())
time_beta <- coef(summary(time_fit))["delay",]
time_or <- exp(time_beta[1]); time_ci <- exp(time_beta[1]+c(-1,1)*1.96*time_beta[2])
time_grid <- tibble(delay=seq(min(time_data$delay),max(time_data$delay),length.out=100))
pr <- predict(time_fit,newdata=time_grid,type="link",se.fit=TRUE)
time_grid <- time_grid |> mutate(prob=plogis(pr$fit),lo=plogis(pr$fit-1.96*pr$se.fit),hi=plogis(pr$fit+1.96*pr$se.fit))
fig_time <- ggplot(time_grid,aes(delay,prob))+geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=lo,ymax=hi),fill="#B9DDD9",alpha=.75)+geom_line(colour="#16857A",linewidth=1.2)+geom_rug(data=time_data,aes(x=delay),inherit.aes=FALSE,alpha=.45,colour="#397FA9")+scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::label_percent(),limits=c(0,1))+labs(x="Sampling-to-POP interval (calendar days)",y="Estimated probability of specific overlap",subtitle="Exploratory logistic model; pointwise 95% Wald confidence band")+theme_classic(base_size=12)
fig_perm <- fig_perm + theme_tim_publication() + theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
fig_time <- fig_time + theme_tim_publication() + theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
subgroup_table <- bind_rows(lapply(c("surgery","sampling"),function(v) sens |> group_by(Group=.data[[v]]) |> summarise(N=n(),positive=sum(preeot_positive),specific=sum(overlap),adequacy_n=sum(adequacy_known),inadequate=sum(adequacy==0,na.rm=TRUE),candidates=sum(candidate %in% TRUE),unknown=sum(is.na(candidate)),.groups="drop") |> mutate(Stratum=v,Yield=mapply(ci_fmt,positive,N),`Specific overlap among positives`=mapply(ci_fmt,specific,positive),Inadequacy=mapply(ci_fmt,inadequate,adequacy_n),`Observed candidates`=mapply(ci_fmt,candidates,N)) |> select(Stratum,Group,N,Yield,`Specific overlap among positives`,Inadequacy,`Observed candidates`,unknown)))
# Aggregate-only export; no patient records or dates.
extra_tables <- list(S4=missing_summary,S5=missing_compare,S6=action_sensitivity,S7=concordance_sensitivity,S8=time_table,S9=subgroup_table)
for(nm in names(extra_tables)) write.csv(extra_tables[[nm]],file.path("publication",paste0("Table_",nm,".csv")),row.names=FALSE,na="")
for(nm in c("S4","S5")) {g<-if(nm=="S4")fig_perm else fig_time; stem<-file.path("publication",paste0("Figure_",nm));ggsave(paste0(stem,".pdf"),g,width=180,height=115,units="mm",device=grDevices::cairo_pdf);ggsave(paste0(stem,".tiff"),g,width=180,height=115,units="mm",dpi=600,compression="lzw")}

# Exploratory adjusted analysis: prespecified here for the reanalysis, not the original protocol.
if (!requireNamespace("logistf", quietly=TRUE)) stop("Install logistf: install.packages('logistf')")
model_data <- data |> transmute(inadequate=1-adequacy, resistance=any_resistance,
 prior_antibiotics=suppressWarnings(as.numeric(antibiotherapie_moins_90j)),
 liver_transplant=as.integer(intervention==1)) |> filter(if_all(everything(), ~ !is.na(.x)))
stopifnot(all(model_data$prior_antibiotics %in% 0:1))
fit_adjusted <- logistf::logistf(inadequate ~ resistance + prior_antibiotics + liver_transplant,
 data=model_data, pl=TRUE)
model_terms <- c("resistance","prior_antibiotics","liver_transplant")
model_table <- tibble(Covariate=c("Reported resistance at POP diagnosis","Antibiotics within 90 days before surgery","Liver transplantation"),
 `Adjusted OR`=exp(fit_adjusted$coefficients[model_terms]),
 `95% CI lower`=exp(fit_adjusted$ci.lower[model_terms]),
 `95% CI upper`=exp(fit_adjusted$ci.upper[model_terms]),
 `P value`=fit_adjusted$prob[model_terms]) |> mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x,3)))

# Downloadable aggregate tables: PDF, paginated, with wrapped cells; no LaTeX required.
if (!requireNamespace("gridExtra", quietly=TRUE)) stop("Install gridExtra: install.packages('gridExtra')")
export_table_pdf <- function(tbl, stem, title) {
 tbl <- as.data.frame(tbl)
 # Landscape for wide tables; wrap long text instead of shrinking it indefinitely.
 wide <- ncol(tbl)>5
 page_w <- if(wide) 16.5 else 11.7
 page_h <- 8.3
 chars <- max(13, floor((page_w*12)/max(1,ncol(tbl))))
 wrap_cell <- function(x) vapply(as.character(x),function(z) if(is.na(z)) "—" else paste(strwrap(z,width=chars),collapse="\n"),character(1))
 tbl[] <- lapply(tbl,wrap_cell); names(tbl) <- wrap_cell(names(tbl))
 row_lines <- if(nrow(tbl)) apply(tbl,1,function(z) max(lengths(strsplit(z,"\n",fixed=TRUE)))) else integer()
 pages <- list(); start <- 1L
 while(start <= nrow(tbl)) {
   end <- start; used <- row_lines[start]+1
   while(end<nrow(tbl) && used+row_lines[end+1]+1 <= 24) {end<-end+1L;used<-used+row_lines[end]+1}
   pages[[length(pages)+1L]] <- tbl[start:end,,drop=FALSE];start<-end+1L
 }
 if(!length(pages)) pages <- list(tbl)
 grDevices::cairo_pdf(file.path("publication",paste0(stem,".pdf")),width=page_w,height=page_h)
 on.exit(grDevices::dev.off(),add=TRUE)
 for(i in seq_along(pages)) {
   g <- gridExtra::tableGrob(pages[[i]],rows=NULL,theme=gridExtra::ttheme_minimal(base_size=9,
     core=list(fg_params=list(hjust=0,x=.03),bg_params=list(fill=c("#F0F5F8","white"),col=NA)),
     colhead=list(fg_params=list(col="white",fontface="bold"),bg_params=list(fill="#234866",col=NA))))
   g$widths <- grid::unit(rep(1,ncol(tbl)),"null")
   grid::grid.newpage()
   grid::pushViewport(grid::viewport(width=.94,height=.92,layout=grid::grid.layout(3,1,heights=grid::unit.c(grid::unit(.65,"in"),grid::unit(1,"null"),grid::unit(.3,"in")))))
   grid::grid.text(paste(strwrap(title,width=100),collapse="\n"),x=0,just="left",gp=grid::gpar(fontsize=13,fontface="bold",col="#234866"),vp=grid::viewport(layout.pos.row=1))
   grid::pushViewport(grid::viewport(layout.pos.row=2)); grid::grid.draw(g);grid::popViewport()
   grid::grid.text(sprintf("TIM POP | %s | Page %d/%d",stem,i,length(pages)),x=0,just="left",gp=grid::gpar(fontsize=9,col="#526577"),vp=grid::viewport(layout.pos.row=3));grid::popViewport()
 }
}
all_tables <- c(list(`1`=table1_publication,`2`=table2_publication,`3`=table3_publication,
 `3b`=adequacy_by_preeot |> transmute(`Pre-extubation culture`=if_else(preeot_positive,"Positive","Negative"),`Inadequate therapy`=sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%)",inadequate,n,inadequate_percent)),
 S1=resistance_summary,S2a=adaptation_by_preeot |> mutate(preeot_positive=if_else(preeot_positive,"Positive","Negative")),
 S2b=adaptation_by_specific_concordance |> mutate(concordant_specific=if_else(concordant_specific,"Yes","No")),
 S3a=outcome_publication,S3b=outcome_tests |> mutate(P_value=signif(P_value,3))),extra_tables,list(S10=model_table))
table_titles <- c(`1`="Patient characteristics",`2`="Microbiological findings",`3`="Antimicrobial management",`3b`="Adequacy by pre-extubation positivity",S1="Resistance phenotypes",S2a="Adaptation by pre-extubation positivity",S2b="Adaptation by specific concordance",S3a="Clinical outcomes",S3b="Exploratory unadjusted comparisons",S4="Availability of analytical variables",S5="Characteristics by adequacy availability",S6="Sensitivity of candidate actionability",S7="Alternative concordance definitions",S8="Concordance by sampling-to-POP interval",S9="Sensitivity by surgery and sampling technique",S10="Exploratory adjusted association with empirical inadequacy")
all_tables$S4 <- missing_summary |> select(-Missing)
all_tables$S5 <- missing_compare |> mutate(SMD=round(SMD,2))
for(nm in names(all_tables)) {
 stem <- paste0("Table_",nm)
 write.csv(all_tables[[nm]],file.path("publication",paste0(stem,".csv")),row.names=FALSE,na="")
 export_table_pdf(all_tables[[nm]],stem,paste0("Table ",nm,". ",table_titles[[nm]]))
}

```

## Table S6 — Sensitivity of candidate actionability

```{r}

```

[Table S6 (PDF)](publication/Table_S6.pdf) · [CSV](publication/Table_S6.csv)

The composite is specific overlap plus inadequate empirical therapy. It is unknown in `r unknown_candidate` patients; absence of overlap makes the composite negative even when adequacy is unavailable. Extreme scenarios bound the composite under the recorded microbiology, not the true clinical benefit. Result availability, susceptibility and coverage of the matching organism require chart adjudication.

## Table S7 — Alternative concordance definitions

```{r}
knitr::kable(concordance_sensitivity,caption="Table S7. Patient-level concordance under alternative organism-set definitions; exact binomial 95% confidence intervals.")
```

[Table S7 (PDF)](publication/Table_S7.pdf) · [CSV](publication/Table_S7.csv)

The main definition requires at least one shared specific organism. More stringent definitions distinguish identical nonempty profiles from coverage of all documented specific POP organisms. Empty profiles never count as matches. These are species-level comparisons, not evidence of strain identity or antibiotic susceptibility.

## Figure S4 — Concordance expected under random pairing

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
fig_perm
```

**Figure S4.** Distribution of specific concordance after 10,000 permutations of complete POP organism profiles among positive pre-EOT patients with known primary microbiology codes. The vertical line denotes observed concordance. Observed concordance was `r fmt(obs_perm,nrow(sp))`, compared with a mean of `r sprintf("%.1f%%",perm_expected)` under random pairing (one-sided Monte Carlo P = `r format.pval(perm_p,digits=3)`). Exchangeability is assumed; shared surgery type, antibiotic exposure or calendar-period ecology may explain part of the association. This is exploratory and does not prove bacterial persistence.

## Table S10 — Exploratory multivariable analysis

```{r}
knitr::kable(model_table,caption="Table S10. Firth penalised logistic regression for empirical antimicrobial inadequacy; adjusted odds ratios and profile penalised likelihood 95% confidence intervals.")
```

[Table S10 (PDF)](publication/Table_S10.pdf) · [CSV](publication/Table_S10.csv)

The complete-case model included `r nrow(model_data)` patients and `r sum(model_data$inadequate)` inadequacy events. Covariates were selected on clinical grounds for this exploratory reanalysis: reported resistance, antibiotic exposure within 90 days before surgery and liver transplantation. The adjusted OR for resistance was `r sprintf("%.2f",model_table[["Adjusted OR"]][1])` (95% CI `r sprintf("%.2f–%.2f",model_table[["95% CI lower"]][1],model_table[["95% CI upper"]][1])`). Penalisation reduces small-sample bias but does not eliminate imprecision, residual confounding or selection bias. Resistance at POP diagnosis is partly linked to the definition of adequacy; this is neither a causal model nor a prospective prediction model.

## Clinical adjudication required before submission

The `r n_specific_actionable` observed candidate cases require review of microbiological result release time, susceptibility availability, whether the shared organism was uncovered by initial therapy, and whether a feasible alternative regimen would cover all relevant pathogens. These items cannot be inferred from sampling dates or species codes. Record them in a secure clinical workspace, not the public HTML. Report aggregate adjudication results only after verification.

## Statistical interpretation and limitations

All additional analyses are exploratory and were developed after inspection of the original results. No multiplicity-adjusted confirmatory claims are made. This retrospective cohort contains only sampled patients who developed POP; it cannot estimate POP incidence, diagnostic performance for incident POP, or the causal benefit of routine sampling. The resistance association is unadjusted and partly reflects the definition of adequacy. A parsimonious exploratory Firth model is reported in Table S10; the small event count limits precision and adjustment for additional covariates. No post-hoc power calculation is used.
